name: Cyber Neon Overdrive
description: High-velocity cybernetic speedway challenge. Dodge laser obstacles, engage nitro boosters, and break supersonic sound barriers in a retro-futuristic metropolis.

name: Hyper Drift 2099
description: Zero-gravity anti-matter racing championship across floating neon skyscrapers and orbital magnetic tracks.

name: Quantum Strike
description: Tactical cybernetic railgun warfare. Infiltrate rogue AI server complexes and dismantle synthetic defense swarms with precision energy blasts.

name: Chrono Blade: Cyber Ronin
description: Fast-paced katana action in Neo-Tokyo. Bend time, parry plasma projectiles, and unleash devastation with razor-sharp photon blades.

name: Neural Matrix Nexus
description: Quantum logic puzzle terminal. Re-align superconducting light nodes, bypass cryptographic firewalls, and unlock artificial intelligence cores.

name: Void Runner
description: Synthwave rhythmic platformer. Sprint across disintegrating neon light beams to the pulsating rhythm of dark synth tracks.
